main.text: The program's entry point. It [prints a greeting](#greet), then [loops five times](#loop).

greet.text: Prints a welcome message built from [this string literal](6:30-6:49).

loop.text: Counts i from 1 to 5. Each pass [prints the counter](#print).

print.text: Prints i joined to text with [string concatenation](#concat). Test data is in [temp.txt](#data).

data.text: Junk test data in another file. Back to [the loop](#loop).
